let s : ℕ → β := t
have h_increasing : ∀ m n, m < n → s m < s n := ht_mono
have h_tends_to_top : ∀ b : β, ∃ n, s n > b := by {
  intro b,
  apply (ht_tendsto).eventually_gt_iff.1,
  intro b',
  exact Filter.atTop eventually_gt_iff.1
}
have h_exists_n : ∃ n, s n > x := h_tends_to_top x
let ⟨n, hn⟩ := h_exists_n
have h_tn_lt_x : s n > x := hn
have h_tn_minus_1_le_x : s (n - 1) ≤ x :=
  by cases n; simp [hn]; exact le_of_lt (lt_trans (s 0 < x) (s 0 < s n))
refine ⟨n - 1, _, _⟩
· rw [Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
  exact h_tn_minus_1_le_x
· rw [Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
  exact lt_trans (h_increasing (n - 1) n (Nat.pos_succ_iff.mp (Nat.succ_ne_zero n))) (s n > x)
